title: Adventures with diphthongs and syllables
summary: Practise finding Spanish diphthongs and splitting words into syllables correctly.
keyIdeas: A diphthong is two vowels pronounced together in the same syllable.
The vowels in a diphthong stay together when we clap the syllables.
Spanish words such as agua, puente and peine have diphthongs.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: In a Spanish diphthong, two vowels are together in the same syllable.
activities.explanation: Correct! The two vowels are pronounced together in one syllable.

activities.prompt: Which Spanish word has a diphthong?
activities.explanation: «Fuego» has a diphthong because u and e are together in the syllable «fue».
activities.hint: Find two vowels together in the same syllable.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish word to its correct syllables.
activities.explanation: The diphthongs ai, ue and io stay together when we split these words into syllables.

activities.prompt: Hugo claps the syllables in «baile». How should he split the word?
activities.explanation: The vowels a and i make a diphthong and stay together: «bai - le».

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by whether they have a diphthong.
activities.explanation: «Flauta» has au and «Viento» has ie. «Pelota» and «Camino» have no vowels next to each other.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Omar and Aisha play in the playground. «cielo» has the diphthong ie.
activities.title: La merienda en el patio
activities.text: Hoy Omar y Aisha juegan en el patio del colegio. El cielo está azul y corre un aire suave. Omar come una manzana dulce y Aisha saca un peine nuevo para su muñeca. Los dos se divierten mucho antes de volver a la clase de música.

questions.prompt: Where do Omar and Aisha play?
questions.explanation: The text says they play in the school playground.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish word from the text has a diphthong?
questions.explanation: «Cielo» has ie in its first syllable: «cie - lo».

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence with the word that has a diphthong.
activities.explanation: «agua» has ua in its second syllable: «a - gua».
activities.hint: Find the word with two vowels together.
activities.sentence: En el recreo, Wei bebe un vaso de ___ fresca.

activities.prompt: Put these Spanish syllables in order to make a word with a diphthong.
activities.explanation: Joining «cua - der - no» makes «cuaderno», with a diphthong in «cua».

activities.prompt: Which Spanish word is split into syllables incorrectly?
activities.explanation: «Re - i - na» is incorrect. The diphthong ei stays together: «rei - na».
activities.hint: Remember that a diphthong's vowels stay together.

activities.prompt: Nerea writes «El pu-en-te es alto». Why is this division into syllables wrong?
activities.explanation: In «puente», u and e make a diphthong. Split it as «puen - te».
activities.hint: Think about how u and e sound together.
options: Because ue is a diphthong and must stay together.
Because the word has missing letters.
Because the word is split into four parts.
